---
title: "Polygenic scores report"
author: "Darren Cameron"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
params:
  scores: null
  summary: null
  qc: null
  qc_steps: null
  pcs: null
  eigenval: null
  ancestry: null
  id_strip: null
  flag_donors: null
  gwas: null
  n_desc: null
  settings: null
  tag: null
  bmark_dir: null
---

***

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(DT)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)

gwas_ids    <- strsplit(params$gwas, ",")[[1]]          # GWAS in config order
flag_donors <- strsplit(params$flag_donors, ",")[[1]]   # donors driving genotype PC1
strip_id    <- function(x) str_remove(x, params$id_strip)  # e.g. 12971_FC -> 12971
qc_files    <- strsplit(params$qc, ",")[[1]]
qc_step_files <- strsplit(params$qc_steps, ",")[[1]]
tag         <- params$tag
bmark_dir   <- params$bmark_dir

split_pairs <- function(x, names) {
  strsplit(x, ";")[[1]] |>
    str_split_fixed("\\|", length(names)) |>
    as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
    set_names(names)
}

settings <- split_pairs(params$settings, c("group", "setting", "value"))
n_desc   <- split_pairs(params$n_desc, c("gwas", "n_method"))

# Deliverable table and per-GWAS summary
scores  <- read_tsv(params$scores, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(iid = col_character())) |>
  mutate(iid_match = strip_id(iid))
summary <- read_tsv(params$summary, show_col_types = FALSE)

pgs_cols <- paste0("pgs_", gwas_ids)
pgs_long <- scores |>
  select(iid, all_of(pgs_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(-iid, names_to = "gwas", values_to = "pgs", names_prefix = "pgs_") |>
  mutate(gwas = factor(gwas, levels = gwas_ids),
         flagged = strip_id(iid) %in% strip_id(flag_donors))

# GWAS QC tables written by format_gwas
qc_long <- map(qc_files, \(f) read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(gwas = factor(gwas, levels = gwas_ids))

qc_steps <- map(qc_step_files, \(f) read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  mutate(gwas = factor(gwas, levels = gwas_ids))

# Within-cohort genotype PCs (PLINK 1.9, no header)
eigenval <- tibble(pc = seq_along(read_lines(params$eigenval)),
                   eigenvalue = as.numeric(read_lines(params$eigenval)))

# Reference-projected ancestry inference (GenotypeQCtoHRC); find the header line
anc_lines <- read_lines(params$ancestry, n_max = 50)
anc_skip  <- which(str_detect(anc_lines, "\\bIID\\b"))[1] - 1
ancestry  <- read_tsv(params$ancestry, skip = anc_skip, show_col_types = FALSE,
                      col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
  mutate(iid_match = strip_id(IID),
         across(c(EUR, PC1, PC2), as.numeric),
         in_pgs = iid_match %in% scores$iid_match,
         flagged = iid_match %in% strip_id(flag_donors))

# Donors in the PGS table far from the European cluster on reference PC1 or PC2
# (robust z > 5 against the GenotypeQCtoHRC European samples)
eur_ref <- filter(ancestry, biogeographic_prediction == "European")
robust_z <- function(x, ref) abs(x - median(ref, na.rm = TRUE)) / mad(ref, na.rm = TRUE)
ancestry <- ancestry |>
  mutate(off_cluster = in_pgs & (robust_z(PC1, eur_ref$PC1) > 5 | robust_z(PC2, eur_ref$PC2) > 5))

scores_anc <- scores |>
  left_join(ancestry |> select(iid_match, ref_PC1 = PC1, ref_PC2 = PC2, ancestry_call = biogeographic_prediction,
                               p_eur = EUR, off_cluster),
            by = "iid_match") |>
  mutate(flagged = iid_match %in% strip_id(flag_donors))

if (anyNA(scores_anc$ancestry_call)) {
  warning("Donors without an ancestry call: ", paste(scores_anc$iid[is.na(scores_anc$ancestry_call)], collapse = ", "))
}

flag_lab <- function(df) filter(df, flagged)
```

***

## PGS pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

We used [PRS-CS](https://github.com/getian107/PRScs) to compute polygenic scores (PGS) for neuropsychiatric conditions and a cortical size factor in the European-ancestry donors of the prenatal brain snRNA-seq cohort. The citation for PRS-CS is [Ge et al. (2019), DOI: 10.1038/s41467-019-09718-5](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-019-09718-5).

***

1. `get_containers`, `get_prscs`, `get_prscs_ref`, `get_gwas_sumstats`: get the container, PRS-CS, the LD reference and the GWAS summary statistics (00SETUP)
2. `euro_samples`, `subset_vcf`, `vcf_to_plink`, `ld_prune`, `genotype_pcs`: European-ancestry donors, PLINK files and genotype PCs (01GENOTYPES)
3. `format_gwas`: format and QC each GWAS for PRS-CS (02PREP-GWAS)
4. `vcf_to_pgen`, `run_prscs`, `combine_weights`, `score`, `combine_scores`: PRS-CS weights, dosage scoring and the combined PGS table (03PRS)
5. `prs_report`: generate this report

***

### Donors and ancestry {.tabset}

***

#### Ancestry calls

***

Donors are those with European ancestry in the sample sheet. Donors called Unclassified by GenotypeQCtoHRC were re-assigned to European in the eQTL study when their posterior probability of European ancestry was high (the tool's European threshold is 0.997).

```{r donors_calls, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
scores_anc |>
  count(ancestry_call, name = "donors") |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t"))
```

***

#### Donors to note

***

Donors re-assigned from Unclassified, flagged in the config (driving within-cohort PC1), or far from the European cluster on the reference PCs (robust z > 5 on PC1 or PC2).

```{r donors_note, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
scores_anc |>
  filter(flagged | off_cluster | ancestry_call != "European") |>
  transmute(donor = iid, ancestry_call, p_eur = round(p_eur, 3),
            ref_PC1 = signif(ref_PC1, 3), ref_PC2 = signif(ref_PC2, 3), flagged, off_cluster) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 50))
```

***

#### Reference PCs

***

PCs from projecting all genotyped samples onto 1000 Genomes (GenotypeQCtoHRC). Donors in the PGS table are outlined; flagged donors and donors far from the European cluster are labelled.

```{r ref_pcs, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim = c(9, 6)}
ggplot(ancestry, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = biogeographic_prediction)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(ancestry, !in_pgs), alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(ancestry, in_pgs), shape = 21, stroke = 0.8, size = 2.5,
             fill = NA) +
  geom_text_repel(data = filter(ancestry, flagged | off_cluster), aes(label = iid_match), colour = "black",
                  size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 30) +
  labs(colour = "GenotypeQCtoHRC call", title = "Reference-projected PCs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

***

#### Cohort PCs

***

PCs computed within the donors in the PGS table (LD-pruned, PLINK 1.9).

```{r cohort_pcs, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim = c(11, 5)}
pc_plt <- ggplot(scores_anc, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = flagged), size = 2.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = flag_lab(scores_anc), aes(label = iid), size = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey50", `TRUE` = "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Within-cohort PCs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

elbow_plt <- ggplot(eigenval, aes(pc, eigenvalue)) +
  geom_line(colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue", size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = eigenval$pc) +
  labs(x = "PC", y = "Eigenvalue", title = "Elbow plot") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

plot_grid(pc_plt, elbow_plt, rel_widths = c(1.4, 1))
```

***

### GWAS QC {.tabset}

***

#### QC steps

***

Each filter is counted for every GWAS, whether or not it is applied. **Failing** is the number of SNPs failing that filter on its own; **remaining** is the number left after the applied filters up to that row (blank if the filter is not applied). The **PRS-CS** columns count only the SNPs PRS-CS would use: rsID with compatible alleles in both the LD reference and the genotype .bim. Rows with an invalid SNP, BETA, SE or P are always removed.

```{r qc_steps, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
fmt_n <- \(x) if_else(is.na(x), "-", format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE))

qc_steps |>
  arrange(gwas) |>
  transmute(GWAS = gwas, Step = label,
            Applied = case_when(is.na(applied) ~ "", applied ~ "yes", TRUE ~ "no"),
            `Failing (file)` = fmt_n(failing), `Failing (PRS-CS)` = fmt_n(failing_overlap),
            `Remaining (file)` = fmt_n(remaining), `Remaining (PRS-CS)` = fmt_n(remaining_overlap)) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
            options = list(dom = "tip", scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10,
                           columnDefs = list(list(className = "dt-right", targets = 3:6))))
```

***

#### SNP overlap check

***

SNPs left after QC among those PRS-CS would use (from `format_gwas`), against the SNPs PRS-CS reported in common across the LD reference, sumstats and genotypes, summed over chromosomes. They should match; a difference means the matching in `format_gwas` does not reproduce PRS-CS's.

```{r qc_overlap, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
qc_steps |>
  filter(!is.na(remaining_overlap)) |>
  group_by(gwas) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(gwas = as.character(gwas), expected = remaining_overlap) |>
  left_join(summary |> transmute(gwas = as.character(gwas), snps_used), by = "gwas") |>
  mutate(match = if_else(expected == snps_used, "yes", "no")) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(gwas = "GWAS", expected = "Expected (format_gwas)", snps_used = "Used (PRS-CS)", match = "Match") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(expected, snps_used), decimals = 0)
```

***

#### Per-SNP N

***

Per-SNP N after QC; n_gwas is the value passed to PRS-CS.

```{r qc_n, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
qc_long |>
  filter(type == "n") |>
  select(gwas, name, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value) |>
  left_join(n_desc |> mutate(gwas = factor(gwas, levels = gwas_ids)), by = "gwas") |>
  select(gwas, n_method, everything()) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x))) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", scrollX = TRUE))
```

***

### PGS distributions

***

Standardised PGS (mean 0, SD 1 across donors). Flagged donors in red.

```{r distributions, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim = c(11, 8)}
ggplot(pgs_long, aes(pgs)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 25, fill = "grey70", colour = "white") +
  geom_rug(data = filter(pgs_long, flagged), colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 1, length = unit(0.08, "npc")) +
  facet_wrap(~ gwas, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Standardised PGS", y = "Donors") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```

***

### PGS correlations

***

Pearson correlations between standardised PGS across `r nrow(scores)` donors. At this sample size each correlation has a 95% interval of roughly &plusmn;`r round(1.96 / sqrt(nrow(scores) - 3), 2)`.

```{r correlations, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim = c(9, 8)}
cor_mat <- cor(scores[pgs_cols])
dimnames(cor_mat) <- list(gwas_ids, gwas_ids)

as_tibble(cor_mat, rownames = "gwas_1") |>
  pivot_longer(-gwas_1, names_to = "gwas_2", values_to = "r") |>
  mutate(gwas_1 = factor(gwas_1, levels = gwas_ids), gwas_2 = factor(gwas_2, levels = rev(gwas_ids))) |>
  ggplot(aes(gwas_1, gwas_2, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "steelblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())
```

***

### Ancestry sensitivity {.tabset}

***

#### Correlation with PCs

***

Correlation of each standardised PGS with within-cohort PCs 1-5 and reference-projected PCs 1-2, in all donors and without the flagged donors.

```{r pc_cor, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
pc_vars <- c(paste0("PC", 1:5), "ref_PC1", "ref_PC2")

pc_cor <- function(df, set) {
  expand_grid(gwas = gwas_ids, pc = pc_vars) |>
    mutate(r = map2_dbl(gwas, pc, \(g, p) cor(df[[paste0("pgs_", g)]], df[[p]], use = "complete.obs")),
           donors = set)
}

bind_rows(pc_cor(scores_anc, "all"),
          pc_cor(filter(scores_anc, !flagged), "without flagged")) |>
  mutate(r = round(r, 2)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = pc, values_from = r) |>
  arrange(factor(gwas, levels = gwas_ids), donors) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 30, scrollX = TRUE))
```

***

#### PGS against PC1

***

```{r pc1_plot, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim = c(11, 9)}
scores_anc |>
  select(iid, flagged, PC1, all_of(pgs_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(pgs_cols), names_to = "gwas", values_to = "pgs", names_prefix = "pgs_") |>
  mutate(gwas = factor(gwas, levels = gwas_ids)) |>
  ggplot(aes(PC1, pgs)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = flagged), size = 1.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey50", `TRUE` = "firebrick"), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ gwas, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Within-cohort PC1", y = "Standardised PGS") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)
```

***

### Adjusted GWAS

***

GWAS-by-subtraction outputs (`<trait>_adj_<trait>`) against the PGS for the trait they are adjusted for and for their parent trait. A negative correlation with the adjusting trait is expected in a target sample even though the latent factors are uncorrelated: estimation error in the adjusting GWAS enters the adjusted GWAS with the opposite sign (our interpretation; not tested here).

```{r adjusted, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim = c(10, 9)}
adj <- tibble(adjusted = gwas_ids[str_detect(gwas_ids, "_adj_")]) |>
  mutate(parent   = str_remove(adjusted, "_adj_.*$"),
         adjusted_for = str_remove(adjusted, "^.*_adj_")) |>
  filter(parent %in% gwas_ids, adjusted_for %in% gwas_ids)

if (nrow(adj) == 0) {
  cat("No adjusted GWAS with both parent and adjusting trait in this run.")
} else {
  adj |>
    pivot_longer(c(parent, adjusted_for), names_to = "comparison", values_to = "other") |>
    mutate(data = map2(adjusted, other, \(a, o) tibble(x = scores[[paste0("pgs_", o)]],
                                                        y = scores[[paste0("pgs_", a)]])),
           r = map_dbl(data, \(d) cor(d$x, d$y)),
           panel = paste0(adjusted, " vs ", other, " (r = ", sprintf("%.2f", r), ")")) |>
    unnest(data) |>
    ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point(colour = "grey40", size = 1.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 2) +
    labs(x = "Standardised PGS (comparison trait)", y = "Standardised PGS (adjusted GWAS)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)
}
```

***

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

```{r benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Rules in this workflow, longest first so e.g. get_prscs_ref is not read as get_prscs
rules <- c("get_containers", "get_prscs", "get_prscs_ref", "get_gwas_sumstats",
           "euro_samples", "subset_vcf", "vcf_to_plink", "ld_prune", "genotype_pcs",
           "format_gwas", "vcf_to_pgen", "run_prscs", "combine_weights", "score",
           "combine_scores", "prs_report")
rules <- rules[order(-nchar(rules))]

files <- list.files(bmark_dir, pattern = "^0[0-3][a-z_]+\\..*\\.benchmark\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

gwas_re <- paste0("^_(", paste(gwas_ids[order(-nchar(gwas_ids))], collapse = "|"), ")(_|$)")

benchmarks <- map(files, function(f) {
  df    <- read.table(f, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
  stem  <- basename(f) |> str_remove("\\.benchmark\\.txt$")
  pipe  <- str_extract(stem, "^[^.]+")
  name  <- str_remove(stem, "^[^.]+\\.")
  rule  <- str_extract(name, paste0("^(", paste(rules, collapse = "|"), ")"))
  rest  <- str_remove(name, paste0("^", rule))
  tibble(pipeline = pipe, rule = rule, rest = rest,
         runtime_sec = df$s, max_rss = df$max_rss)
}) |>
  list_rbind()

# Keep only current GWAS and the current PRS-CS tag, so old runs drop out
benchmarks <- benchmarks |>
  filter(!is.na(rule),
         rest == "" | str_detect(rest, gwas_re) | str_detect(rest, "^_a\\d+_b"),
         !str_detect(rest, "_a\\d+_b") | str_detect(rest, fixed(tag)))

summary_bm <- benchmarks |>
  group_by(pipeline, rule) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec) / 60,
            sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec) / 60,
            mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss) / 1024,
            sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss) / 1024,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
         sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3))) |>
  arrange(pipeline, rule)

summary_bm |>
  gt(groupname_col = "pipeline") |>
  tab_header(title = "Table X. Benchmarking", subtitle = "Means and SD across jobs") |>
  cols_label(rule = "Rule", n = "N", mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
             sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)", mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)", sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)") |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb), decimals = 2) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(14),
              table.border.top.style = "none",
              table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
              table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
              table.border.bottom.color = "black",
              heading.align = "center") |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_column_labels(everything()))
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r runtime_plt, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim = c(10, 6)}
runtime_plt <- ggplot(summary_bm, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_runtime_min), y = mean_runtime_min)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_runtime_min - sd_runtime_min, ymax = mean_runtime_min + sd_runtime_min),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "Runtime (minutes)", title = "Mean runtime per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 16))

mem_plt <- ggplot(summary_bm, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_ram_gb), y = mean_ram_gb)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_ram_gb - sd_ram_gb, ymax = mean_ram_gb + sd_ram_gb),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "RAM (GB)", title = "Mean RAM usage per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14), axis.title = element_text(size = 16))

plot_grid(runtime_plt, mem_plt)
```
